name: BottomNavigationBar
description: A widget that displays a navigation bar at the bottom of the screen, allowing the user to switch between different views or pages.

properties.name: items
properties.description: The widgets to display as the bottom navigation items.

properties.name: currentIndex
properties.description: The index of the currently selected item.

properties.name: onTap
properties.description: Called when an item is tapped, providing its index.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The color of the navigation bar background.

properties.name: selectedItemColor
properties.description: The color of the selected item.

properties.name: unselectedItemColor
properties.description: The color of the unselected items.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The layout behavior of the navigation bar. Fixed shows all items, shifting animates changes.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the navigation bar, affecting shadow size.

properties.name: showSelectedLabels
properties.description: Whether to show labels for selected items.

properties.name: showUnselectedLabels
properties.description: Whether to show labels for unselected items.
